d: US president Donald Trump is expelling South Africa and Rwanda from the African Growth and Opportunity Act, or AGOA. AGOA allows African nations to export goods to the US duty free. The Trump administration says that Pretoria and Kigali have undermined Washington's foreign policy, and violated the requirements to be part of AGOA. Firstpost explains why Trump is kicking South Africa and Rwanda out of AGOA by January 1, 2027. Alyson Le Grange looks at the potential impact of South Africa and Rwanda getting ejected from AGOA. Alyson Le Grange brings you more on Firstpost Africa.
